question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

HAMPER
solution:
The correct answer is: restrict

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Hamper (रुकना) means to restrict the movement of bonds or obstacles: impede.

 
 
• Example - *The building work was **hampered **by bad weather.*
 
 
 
• Marked option Restrict (प्रतिबंध लगाना) means to limit someone's actions or movement, or to limit the amount, size, etc.
 
 
• Example - *There is a plan to **restrict **the use of cars in the area.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that 'Hamper' and 'Restrict' are similar in meaning.
 
• Therefore the correct answer is option 2.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Punish **(सज़ा देना) means to make somebody suffer because he/she has done something bad or wrong.
 
• **Adhere **(मानना) means to continue to support an idea, etc; to follow a rule.
 
• **Absolve **(दोषमुक्त करना) means to be free from guilt or blame or their consequences.
